people.name: Asa
people.line: King of Judah, son of Abijah; father of Jehoshaphat

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Omri
people.line: King of Israel; father of Ahab

people.name: Tirzah
people.line: Canaanite city that became the capital of Israel

translations.web: In the thirty-first year of Asa king of Judah, Omri began to reign over Israel for twelve years. He reigned six years in Tirzah.
translations.bsb: In the thirty-first year of Asa’s reign over Judah, Omri became king of Israel, and he reigned twelve years, six of them in Tirzah.
translations.kjv: In the thirty and first year of Asa king of Judah began Omri to reign over Israel, twelve years: six years reigned he in Tirzah.
translations.asv: In the thirty and first year of Asa king of Judah began Omri to reign over Israel, and reigned twelve years: six years reigned he in Tirzah.
